service: Biometric enrolment of census-verified civil servants (Manuel de procédures d'enrôlement biométrique des agents civils de l'Etat)
title: Décret n° 2020-651 portant approbation du manuel de procédures d'enrôlement biométrique des agents civils de l'Etat recensés (Journal officiel n° 49-2020, with manual annexed)
authority: Ministère de la Fonction publique, de la Réforme de l'Etat, du Travail et de la Sécurité sociale (decree of the Prime Minister; published by Secrétariat général du Gouvernement)
locator: JO pp. 1235-1238: manual sections I (Organisation), III (Collecte des données, tasks 1-7), IV (Vérification et prélèvement: team composition, 'Actions à exécuter' table)
finding: The annexed manual sets an interministerial commission (coordination nationale, supervision, chef de projet métier, five sous-commissions), six sequential phases, and per-phase tasks: the fonction publique ministry edits agent lists by direction, NIU project and ministry jointly issue the list of documents, in-situ teams (chef d'équipe, 3 opérateurs de saisie, 2 vérificateurs, 2 agents du contentieux, structure representative) authenticate dossier documents via the control platform, capture biometrics, and route disputes to site/coordination contentieux.
limitations: Host copy is on unicongo.cg (business federation) mirror of the official JO; the official sgg.cg copy was not opened. One-off census operation (2020) rather than a recurring citizen service; internal HR/payroll-integrity function.

service: Immigration decisions: visas, entry permission, refusal, detention (Immigration Procedures certified under Immigration Act 2019)
title: Immigration Procedures, Certified under the Immigration Act 2019, Version 1
authority: Kiribati Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration
document_date: Dated 31 December 2019 (certified under s.16 Immigration Act 2019), Version 1
locator: 128-page PDF; Part A Core principles (decision making, decision makers); entry-permission section items 11-12 (grant as exception, withdrawal for administrative error); detention/custody passages
finding: Officer-facing manual: immigration officers must interview before granting entry permission as an exception, weigh listed factors (a-c), record reasons in Ministry records; must give written reasons for a decline; may withdraw entry permission for administrative error before the person leaves the control area; custody requires inventory and specified steps; employer 'genuine attempt' test for work visas.
limitations: Version 1 of 2019/2020; no evidence of later revisions. Text is prose instructions rather than flowcharts, but it names actors, decisions and sequence.

service: Government records management: opening, indexing, transferring and disposing of files in ministry registries

finding: Step-by-step registry procedures for government ministries: records staff check file list/index before opening a file, Head of Records Management Section must approve new files, file jackets/titles/reference numbers assigned per rules, transfer slips replace misfiled documents, closed files listed and transferred to the Records Centre/Archives Department.
limitations: 2006 edition, no evidence it has been updated; WebFetch could not parse it (encrypted/image PDF) but pdftotext extracted the full text. Internal admin function, not a citizen service.

service: Customs clearance at Lomé Port: vessel arrival, unloading, warehousing (MAD), transfer, exit and release of goods and vehicles
title: Manuel de procédures de dédouanement de la Direction des Opérations Douanières de Lomé-Port (DODLP), Réf. OTR/Pr-Pd/DLP/Man/002, Version 002
authority: Office Togolais des Recettes (OTR) – Commissariat des Douanes et Droits Indirects, DODLP; hosted on the Togo Trade Portal (Ministère du Commerce)
locator: 184-page PDF; Première partie (acteurs, fiches de poste); Procédure N°1 'Conduite et mise en douane' (DIMP-DLP-01-02) step table (Etapes/Intervenants/Description des tâches/Délais/Documents) and swimlane flowchart Phase 1; Procédures N°2-4 (entrée en MAD, transfert PIIA, sortie des MAD)
finding: Quality-management procedure manual with per-procedure step tables and swimlane diagrams: e.g. consignee lodges manifest electronically in SYDONIA World/GUCE, DODLP verifies conformity (reject/authorise), notifies chef de division and chef de brigade; brigade agents draft the differential-state report, Chef de Brigade drafts the PV (10 min) and transmits to chef de division, who validates (5 min) and transmits to DODLP, which notifies the consignee and opens contentious proceedings; vérificateurs are assigned timed tasks in later procedures.
limitations: Scope limited to the Lomé-Port directorate of customs; 18 MB PDF, WebFetch could not parse it (downloaded with curl and read with pdftotext). Edition 2020; no later version seen.

title: Manual de Procedimientos: Atención Primaria, Modelo de Gestión Fiscalía Metropolitana, Versión 2.0
authority: Ministerio Público – Procuraduría General de la Nación, Oficina de Implementación del Sistema Penal Acusatorio (Resolución N°01 de 01-01-2023)
locator: 68-page PDF; Section IV 'Procedimientos de la Sección de Atención Primaria': Procedimiento I 'Unidad de Recepción de Denuncias' with flowcharts 1.3.1/1.3.3/1.3.5/1.3.7 and narratives 1.3.2 (MP-SPA-SAP-01, p. 22), Procedimiento II 'Unidad de Actos Urgentes' (Trámite de la Carpeta, p. 40-41)
finding: Procedure narratives in role/task/description/documents format: the Fiscal interviews the victim or complainant; if the facts are outside Ministerio Público competence the person is oriented via form FMP-05 and the process ends; if in competence and the user is in crisis or the offence is on a listed set, the Fiscal refers to UPAVIT for emotional support via its work-request form, then takes the statement; later steps route the file (carpeta) and coordinate with DIJ/IMELCF.
limitations: Scope is the Metropolitan prosecutor's office model; other Panama leads (MEF treasury procedures, Contraloría caja menuda manual 2006) exist but were not fully assessed.

authority: Kementerian Pendayagunaan Aparatur Negara dan Reformasi Birokrasi (copy hosted by Inspektorat Jenderal, Kementerian Pertahanan)

title: Административный регламент государственной услуги «Тиражирование статистических данных (бумажной версии)...» (утверждён приказом Нацстаткома КР от 26 апреля 2019 г. № 52)
authority: Национальный статистический комитет Кыргызской Республики
locator: Section 1 (общие положения, service term 1-30 days); Table 2 'Процедура 1-3' with columns: действие, исполнитель/должностное лицо, продолжительность, регулирующий документ, результат
finding: Step table assigns each action to a named unit/position with time limits: specialists of the statistical-instruments and procurement department receive and review the application (20 min; register or refuse on listed grounds), general-department specialist passes it for resolution (30-60 min) and routes it to the printing department (10 min), department specialist agrees the contract with the customer (10 days), reproduction (20 days), applicant informed (10 min) and output registered (30 min).

service: Government capital project management: stage-gate approvals from initiation to closing
title: Project Management Manual (PMM)
authority: Projects, Tenders and Local Content Authority (PTLC), Sultanate of Oman
document_date: not resolved (PDF metadata April 2026; no printed edition date seen)
locator: 54-page PDF; Section 3 Roles and Responsibilities (Project Sponsor, Project Manager, Stage Gate Review Committee, Decision Review Board, Ministry of Economy, Ministry of Finance, PTLC); Section 4 Phases 0-6 with SGR-0 to SGR-6 and DRB gates; 2.11 Project Charter
finding: Defines a seven-phase lifecycle with stage-gate reviews: after approval and budget allocation the project manager prepares a Project Charter signed off by the Project Sponsor; an SGR-1 evaluation team includes Ministry of Finance and Project Follow-up Office members; each phase ends with an SGR/DRB decision on whether to proceed; after the warranty period the Project Manager submits a final close-out report to the SGR-6 committee; value engineering mandatory for projects >= 10 million OMR in phases 3-4.
limitations: Framework-level manual for all government entities; detailed sub-procedures are in appendices/templates. The SAI 'Operational and Strategic Audit Toolkit' (opened) is a second candidate (audit steps, concerned employees, deliverables) but is older (c. 2015).

service: Registration and approval of automobile assemblers and component manufacturers (Ministry of Industries SOP)
title: Standard Operating Procedures for Automobile Manufacturing Industry, Government of Sri Lanka, Version 2
authority: Ministry of Industries, Policy Development Division (Cabinet decisions of 16.12.2020 and 11.01.2021)
locator: Section 3 'Registration' process tables (3.4.1.1 onwards: Process / Responsibility / Min. duration / Information to be provided / Remarks), CAC (committee) composition and evaluation clauses
finding: Process tables assign each step to a responsible body: Ministry of Industries, IDB and DMT publish forms and information; applicant submits form 112/R with 19 listed documents to MI & IDB; the Committee (CAC, with nominated deputy-head-level representatives) evaluates and decides registration, with validity and assessment-letter timelines; technical conditions (CKD component separation) are specified for inspection.

The NCCP 'SOP for Hospice Programme' (2022, opened) is a standards document for hospices with few internal steps; the Auditor General's procurement audit manual refused connection.

service: Maintenance and updating of the Unified Voter Register (Jedinstveni birački spisak): processing change requests before and after the register is closed
title: Приручник за спровођење Закона о јединственом бирачком списку
authority: Министарство државне управе и локалне самоуправе (with the Standing Conference of Towns and Municipalities)
locator: Part V 'Поступак вођења и ажурирања бирачког списка' (3.2 changes on party request, 3.4 on request of list submitter); Part VI-VII updating after elections are called / after closure (1.1 receipt of requests p. 43, 1.2 forwarding to Ministry, 2.1 closure and printing, 2.3 deciding on requests); Part 6 software screens (6.1.3 creating a request, 6.1.6 issuing a decision)
finding: Instructs municipal/city administrations and the Ministry step by step: after closure of the register until 72 hours before election day, decisions are issued by the Ministry; requests are lodged with the Ministry or the municipal administration of residence; the official authorised for updating forwards complete requests with attachments electronically to the Ministry without delay (at latest next day), local bodies must accept requests outside working hours; the Ministry then decides, closes and prints the register; screen-level instructions cover creating requests and issuing decisions in the JBS application.
limitations: Co-published with an association of municipalities; executed partly by local governments under ministry authority. 2019 edition.

service: Government payments: certification of invoices, payment vouchers, imprests and advances (Financial Instructions)
title: Financial Instructions, 2022 Revised Edition (CAP 4.20.1)
authority: Ministry of Finance and Economic Development, Government of Tuvalu (issued by the Secretary under the Public Finance Act)
locator: 62-page PDF; Chapter 2 roles (Minister, Secretary, Planning Budget and Aid Coordination Dept, Treasury, Accounting Officers); 'Payment Vouchers' instructions 155-160 (p. 34); Chapter 8 Imprests and Advances
finding: Numbered instructions assign actions and sequence: the Accounting Officer certifies the supplier invoice ('Goods Received, Ok to Pay') after checking goods, price and purchase order; the Treasury Officer prepares the Payment Voucher in the FMIS within three days; payroll vouchers are prepared by Treasury and additionally certified by the Secretary; Treasury may withhold payment where commitments lack a purchase order.
limitations: Published as subordinate legislation (CAP 4.20.1) on the legislation site, but drafted as operational instructions with roles and steps; amendments of 2020 and 2024 exist on finance.gov.tv. The MICRO2 Project Operation Manual lead is a World Bank project manual (not opened; >10 MB).
